# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to understand and ''speak'' the language of any one tree
species.
@@ 2
Allows the caster to appear as any one type of tree. Caster retains his size
and will not smell or feel like the tree (i.e. it is purely a visual illusion
and is subject to normal illusion rules; see Spell Law Section 15.14 for more
on illusions).
@@ 3
Heals 3d10 hits of damage on a tree.
@@ 4
Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorns. The wall is up to
10'x10'x5'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 50%. All attacks
through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. Anyone moving rhrough it receives a
takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).
@@ 5
For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 3.
@@ 6
All non-magical fire in the area of effect is put out. Magical fire must make
an RR or be extinguished.
@@ 7
Caster magically enters a tree and can leave from any other tree within range.
@@ 8
Creates a wall of tough branches that is 10'x10'x1'. All movement through the
wall is reduced by 80%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penaliy.
Anyone passing through it takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).
@@ 9
For the duration. caster's skin is treated as AT 8.
@@ 10
Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating (Tree will
perform similarly to an Awakened Tree).
@@ 11
As Tree Healing, except that in addition, the tree is cured of any diseases.
@@ 12
Creates a wall of trees in the area of effect. The trees can be burned through
or chopped down. They are rooted to the ground. The actual height of the trees
will vary according to the trees in the area.
@@ 13
Target is rooted to the ground. He may make a Very Hard maneuver to break
free. While rooted, all Unbalancing criticals are lowered by two degrees
(i.e., a 'C' critical would become an 'A' critical, a 'B' critical would
become an 'A' critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical
would become an 'A' critical with a special modification of -50).
@@ 14
For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 11.
@@ 15
Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating (Tree will
perform similarly to a Slowroot).
@@ 16
As Smother, except for the area of effect and range, and magical fires suffer
-20 to their RRs.
@@ 17
As Treeport, except for range.
@@ 18
For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 20.
@@ 19
Caster can revive any one dead tree.
@@ 20
Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating (Tree will
perform similar to a Treeherd).
@@ 25
Caster can take the form, physical size, and abilities of any one tree with
which he is familiar (GM's discretion).
@@ 30
As Smother, except for area of effect, range, and magical fires suffer -50 to
their RRs.
@@ 50
Caster can either issue a summons to every sentient tree within a forest, or
animate one tree per level and bring them all to fight for a cause that is
crucial to the forest's survival (Trees are animated as in Command Tree, GM's
discretion).
